prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Two office visits were completed. Radiographs demonstrated a distal radius fracture consistent with the reported mechanism of injury, and the nature and force of the collision are well matched to this type of injury. On examination, localized tenderness, swelling, and reduced grip strength were documented over the fracture site, while neurovascular testing of the hand and sensation in the fingers were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this wrist. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typically expected for this fracture, and the patient remains in a removable splint with a follow-up scheduled for further assessment. Billing records from the two visits show single charges for each service with no duplicate entries.
